name: biblioteca-lumen
description: Sistema full-stack de administración de biblioteca con pruebas automatizadas

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:e2e: concurrently --kill-others --success command-E2E -n API,WEB,E2E -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run start:test" "npm run dev:test" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3100/health http://127.0.0.1:5175 && npm run cypress:run"
scripts.start:test: cross-env PORT=3100 ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true DB_PATH=.data/e2e.db npm run start -w backend
scripts.start:load: cross-env PORT=3100 DB_PATH=.data/load.db npm run start -w backend
scripts.dev:test: cross-env VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 npm run dev --workspace frontend -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5175 --strictPort
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
